script = """from src.semver.version import Version

# Test bump_build with non-numeric build
v1 = Version.parse("1.2.3+alpha")
print(f"Before bump_build: {repr(v1)}, build={repr(v1.build)}")
bumped1 = v1.bump_build()
print(f"After bump_build: {repr(bumped1)}, build={repr(bumped1.build)}")

# Test bump_build with numeric build
v2 = Version.parse("1.2.3+build.9")
print(f"Before bump_build: {repr(v2)}, build={repr(v2.build)}")
bumped2 = v2.bump_build()
print(f"After bump_build: {repr(bumped2)}, build={repr(bumped2.build)}")
"""
r = await world.call('repo.write_file', path='test_current.py', content=script)
print(r)

2. `'1٢.2.3'` matches because `\d` in Python 3 matches Unicode digits including Arabic-Indic.
